reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to owner-operators of 1–10 person businesses in Bareni's calm, practical tone, respecting the no-CTA rule and human approval bounds.
reasons.clarity: Logical, clean progression from the concept of weekly rhythm to concrete diagnostic criteria and a clear scoping question.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, bounded exercise to map a recurring task against the week and evaluate whether automation fits.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to Bareni boundaries, making no unsubstantiated capability, customer, or performance claims.
